threshold_scale: Fraction of maximum centered squared high-pass envelope over complete FIR and envelope support
qmf_design: 64-tap symmetric linear-phase near-PR, coefficients pinned in src/lee/Qmf.h
lpc_gain: Square root of unnormalized autocorrelation prediction energy; paper gain normalization unspecified
analysis_boundary: Zero extension with full FIR transients before decimation
detector_boundary: Exclude incomplete FIR/envelope support and do not count the first valid sample as a rising edge
notch_isolation: Greedy prominence selection with nonoverlapping pole half-bandwidths (BW - 2 log(0.95))/2, excluding DC/Nyquist overlap
